requirements.summary: Deploy and publish the ZoritLegends application to the Internet Computer network, making it publicly accessible
acceptanceCriteria: The application is successfully deployed to the Internet Computer
The published app is publicly accessible via its canister URL
Both frontend and backend canisters are live and functional

file_operations.description: Verify all navigation links and routing work correctly before deployment; ensure the Navbar component properly handles all page transitions and auth state in the production environment

Ensure TanStack Router configuration is production-ready with all routes (home, team) properly registered and navigable; verify AuthProvider wraps the entire routing tree correctly for the deployed environment
Verify backend actor initialization uses the correct production canister IDs and hosts; ensure the actor properly connects to the deployed backend canister on the Internet Computer network
Confirm React app entry point with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider is configured for production deployment; ensure proper initialization order and error boundaries
Verify HTML shell loads production-optimized bundle correctly and all meta tags are appropriate for public deployment
